compartments.raw_text: Susceptible (S). They may die from unrelated causes and exit the system, or they may be infected either by an infectious individual or corpse and become non-symptomatic infected (E).
compartments.text_span: Susceptible (S). They may die from unrelated causes and exit the system, or they may be infected either by an infectious individual or corpse and become non-symptomatic infected (E).
compartments.description: Individuals who may die from unrelated causes and exit the system, or they may be infected either by an infectious individual or corpse and become non-symptomatic infected.

compartments.raw_text: Non-symptomatic infected individuals (E) do not become infectious dead if they die at the background death rate.
compartments.text_span: Non-symptomatic infected individuals (E) do not become infectious dead if they die at the background death rate.
compartments.description: Individuals who are infected but not yet symptomatic.

compartments.raw_text: Infectious individuals (I) may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment.
compartments.text_span: Infectious individuals (I) may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment.
compartments.description: Individuals who are symptomatic and capable of spreading the disease.

compartments.raw_text: The infected deceased compartment (D) represents the dead bodies of previously infected individuals who are still capable of infecting susceptible individuals.
compartments.text_span: The infected deceased compartment (D) represents the dead bodies of previously infected individuals who are still capable of infecting susceptible individuals.
compartments.description: The dead bodies of previously infected individuals who are still capable of infecting susceptible individuals.

compartments.raw_text: Recovered individuals can no longer be infected; they die at the background death rate.
compartments.text_span: Recovered individuals can no longer be infected; they die at the background death rate.
compartments.description: Individuals who have recovered from the disease and are immune to reinfection.

flows.raw_text: Susceptible individuals may die and leave the population at the background death rate (µS), or they may be infected and enter the non-symptomatic infected compartment (E) at the infection rate that is represented by the two fractions.
flows.text_span: Susceptible individuals may die and leave the population at the background death rate (µS), or they may be infected and enter the non-symptomatic infected compartment (E) at the infection rate that is represented by the two fractions.
flows.description: Susceptible individuals become infected through contact with infected individuals or corpses.

flows.raw_text: Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic, thereby leaving the compartment and joining the symptomatic infected compartment at rate ωE.
flows.text_span: Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic, thereby leaving the compartment and joining the symptomatic infected compartment at rate ωE.
flows.description: Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic.

flows.raw_text: Symptomatic infectious individuals may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment, where they are immune to infection.
flows.text_span: Symptomatic infectious individuals may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment, where they are immune to infection.
flows.description: Infectious individuals recover from the disease.

flows.raw_text: Infectious individuals can recover (R) from the disease or they may die at the background death rate (αI) and become an infectious dead body (DI).
flows.text_span: Infectious individuals can recover (R) from the disease or they may die at the background death rate (αI) and become an infectious dead body (DI).
flows.description: Infectious individuals may die from the disease and become infectious deceased.

flows.raw_text: The infected deceased (D) are included in the denominator for the rate of infections since they are interacting with susceptible individuals.
flows.text_span: The infected deceased (D) are included in the denominator for the rate of infections since they are interacting with susceptible individuals.
flows.description: Infectious dead bodies infect susceptible individuals through contact.

flows.raw_text: Recovered individuals can no longer be infected; they die at the background death rate.
flows.text_span: Recovered individuals can no longer be infected; they die at the background death rate.
flows.description: Recovered individuals die at the background death rate.
